---
title: "TAOOH first-order Markov model — estimand"
subtitle: "Weeks alive and out of hospital over 26 weeks"
format: html
---

- Same estimand and participants as the second-order model

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(mostr)
library(ggdist)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "posterior.R"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)
n_draws <- config$posterior_draws$main

horizon_days <- config$analysis$horizon_days
stopifnot(horizon_days %% 7 == 0)
horizon_weeks <- as.integer(horizon_days / 7)

results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "04-first-order-markov", "results")
model_dir <- here(results_dir, "models")
estimand_dir <- here(results_dir, "estimand")
figure_dir <- here(results_dir, "figures")
dir.create(estimand_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Per-imputation post-estimation files carry the number of draws in their
# name, so changing posterior_draws$main recomputes them.
estimand_path <- function(kind, index) {
  here(estimand_dir, sprintf("%s-%02d-draws-%d.parquet", kind, index, n_draws))
}
```

## Post-estimation per imputation

```{r}
#| label: post-estimation
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  if (file.exists(estimand_path("comparisons-draws", index))) next

  model <- readRDS(here(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index)))

  sops <- avg_sops(
    model = model,
    variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
    times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
    y_levels = 1:5,
    absorb = 5L,
    p_var = "yprev",
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    include_re = TRUE,
    n_draws = n_draws,
    seed = index,
    posterior_summary = "median",
    return_draws = TRUE
  )

  comparisons <- avg_comparisons(
    model = model,
    variables = list(tx = c(0, 1)),
    estimand = "time_in_state",
    state_sets = 1L,
    times = seq_len(horizon_weeks),
    y_levels = 1:5,
    absorb = 5L,
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    p_var = "yprev",
    include_re = TRUE,
    n_draws = n_draws,
    seed = index,
    posterior_summary = "median",
    return_draws = TRUE
  )

  sop_draws <- attr(sops, "draws")
  comparison_draws <- attr(comparisons, "draws")
  stopifnot(
    "First-order TAOOH post-estimation must retain posterior draws." =
      !is.null(sop_draws) && !is.null(comparison_draws)
  )

  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(sops),
    estimand_path("sops-summary", index),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(sop_draws),
    estimand_path("sops-draws", index),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(comparisons),
    estimand_path("comparisons-summary", index),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
  # Written last: its existence marks the imputation as complete.
  write_parquet(
    as.data.frame(comparison_draws),
    estimand_path("comparisons-draws", index),
    compression = "zstd"
  )
}
```

## Pooled treatment difference

```{r}
#| label: pool-comparisons
#| include: false

pooled <- indices |>
  map(\(index) {
    draws <- read_parquet(estimand_path("comparisons-draws", index)) |>
      as.data.frame()

    stopifnot(
      "First-order TAOOH contrasts must contain draw_id and estimate." =
        all(c("draw_id", "estimate") %in% names(draws)),
      "Each first-order fit must provide one contrast per posterior draw." =
        nrow(draws) == n_draws && !anyDuplicated(draws$draw_id)
    )

    draws |>
      mutate(imputation = index, draw = estimate) |>
      select(
        draw_id,
        imputation,
        draw,
        any_of(c("contrast", "comparison", "term", "state"))
      )
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

home_time_summary <- summarize_posterior_draws(pooled$draw) |>
  mutate(
    probability_benefit = posterior_probability(pooled$draw),
    state = 1L,
    horizon_weeks = horizon_weeks,
    imputations = length(indices),
    draws_per_imputation = n_draws
  )

write_parquet(
  as.data.frame(home_time_summary),
  here(results_dir, "home-time-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
write_parquet(
  pooled,
  here(results_dir, "home-time-comparison-draws.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

## Pooled state occupancy probabilities

```{r}
#| label: pool-state-occupancy
#| include: false

state_labels <- c(
  "Alive/out of hospital",
  "Planned admission",
  "Emergency room",
  "Unplanned admission",
  "Dead"
)

sop_draws <- indices |>
  map(\(index) {
    draws <- read_parquet(estimand_path("sops-draws", index)) |>
      as.data.frame()

    stopifnot(
      "First-order SOP draws lack required columns." =
        all(c("draw_id", "estimate", "time", "state", "tx") %in% names(draws)),
      "Each first-order SOP object must contain the configured draws." =
        n_distinct(draws$draw_id) == n_draws
    )

    draws |>
      mutate(imputation = index)
  }) |>
  list_rbind()

pooled_sop_summary <- sop_draws |>
  mutate(
    state = factor(state, levels = 1:5, labels = state_labels),
    tx = factor(tx, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Usual care", "ctDNA"))
  ) |>
  group_by(tx, time, state) |>
  summarise(
    conf.low = quantile(estimate, 0.025, names = FALSE),
    conf.high = quantile(estimate, 0.975, names = FALSE),
    estimate = median(estimate),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_parquet(
  pooled_sop_summary,
  here(results_dir, "state-occupancy-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: build-figures
#| include: false

model_sop_plot <- plot_sops(
  pooled_sop_summary |> mutate(tx = fct_relevel(tx, "ctDNA")),
  time_var = "time",
  facet_var = NULL,
  linetype_var = "tx"
) +
  scale_colour_state() +
  scale_fill_state() +
  scale_linetype_group() +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2),
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2),
    linetype = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = NA))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Week after random selection",
    y = "State occupancy probability",
    colour = "TAOOH state",
    fill = "TAOOH state",
    linetype = NULL,
    title = NULL
  )

save_figure(
  model_sop_plot,
  here(figure_dir, "model-state-occupancy-pooled.png"),
  height = 5
)

home_time_posterior_plot <- plot_posterior(
  pooled,
  x_label = paste0(
    "Difference in time alive and out of hospital over ",
    horizon_weeks,
    " weeks (ctDNA − usual care), weeks"
  )
)

save_figure(
  home_time_posterior_plot,
  here(figure_dir, "home-time-difference-posterior.png"),
  height = 5
)
```
